name: Eldora Lyon to Meikyuu no Shuujin
original_name: エルドラ リヨンと迷宮の囚人
source:
Lyon, son of Lord Gilbert, is in love with Marco. Marco finally accepts his feelings, but the pair gets interrupted and ridiculed by cousin George. Then mysterious middle-aged man appears and captures cousin Klaus. Will there ever be private time for these two people?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-september-2008-sumaga.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
吉尔伯特勋爵的儿子里昂爱上了马可。马可最终接受了自己的感受，但两人却遭到表弟乔治的打断和嘲笑。这时神秘的中年男子出现并抓住了表弟克劳斯。这两个人会有私人时间吗？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-september-2008-sumaga.html]vndbreview[/url]]
